verdicts.actual: FY26 services revenue growth 4.75-5.25% cc guided; Q3 FY26 revenue +4.8% YoY cc
verdicts.verdict: Guidance raised twice through the year; Q3 growth 4.8% sits within the final 4.75-5.25% range.

verdicts.actual: FY27 guidance 2.5-4% cc; Q2 FY27 services revenue +4% YoY
verdicts.verdict: FY27 not over; guidance narrowed upward to 2.5-4% and H1 services growth of 4% is consistent.
Full-year EBIT margin of 17.2% lands inside the guided 17-18% band.

verdicts.actual: FY27 EBIT margin guidance 17.5-18.5%; Q2 FY27 EBIT margin 18.2%
verdicts.verdict: FY27 not over; margin set at 17.5-18.5% and Q2's 18.2% is tracking within range.

out.read: Management has so far delivered on FY26 revenue and margin guidance and is tracking within its FY27 ranges, though FY27 remains open.
